summary.headline: Astronomical Cycles and Ptolemy’s Fruit
summary.text: Descriptions of Neapolitan codices 20 and 21. Codex 20 includes astronomical calculations for calendars, Easter, indiction, bissextile, lunar, solar, sea, and earth cycles, interpretations of the Sun and Moon, seasonal lore, zodiacal seismology, and a monthly brontologion; codex 21 contains Pindar’s Olympian Odes and Claudius Ptolemy’s Fruit in 100 chapters.
